nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: The Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 crystals were fabricated on NF by a facile one-step hydrothermal method, where NF is used as both the Ni source and substrate.
nodes.source_text: The Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 crystals were fabricated on NF by a facile one-step hydrothermal method, where NF is used as both the Ni source and substrate (Figure 1a).

nodes.name: In situ electrochemical activation
nodes.procedure: The obtained Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 crystal is activated in situ by a chronoamperometry method in 1 M KOH at room temperature (denoted EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4), during which the current density gradually increases from -23 to -51 mA cm^{-2} and remains stable after 20 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: Seven well-defined diffraction peaks at 19.5°, 31.6°, 37.2°, 38.7°, 55.8°, 59.6° and 65.2° indexed to (111), (220), (311), (222), (422), (511), and (440) planes of spinel Co₃O₄. After activation, peaks weaken due to decreased crystallinity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern of the obtained sample, seven well-defined diffraction peaks are observed at 19.5, 31.6, 37.2, 38.7, 55.8, 59.6 and 65.2° ... which can be well indexed to the (111), (220), (311), (222), (422), (511), and (440) planes of the spinel Co₃O₄

nodes.characterization_summary: NF skeleton fully covered by polyhedral crystals forming three-dimensional hierarchical porous structure. EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 inherits original polyhedral morphology with no fracture or shedding.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A scanning electron microscopy (SEM) image shows that the NF skeleton is fully covered by the polyhedral crystals ... SEM images show that EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 inherits the original polyhedral morphology, and no apparent fracture or shedding is found

properties.description: Black and white SEM image of nanoparticles

nodes.characterization_summary: Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 shows polyhedral particles several micrometers in diameter with smooth surface. EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 shows loose surface structure consisting of irregular-shaped particles with grain size ~10-20 nm and polycrystalline nature confirmed by SAED.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A transmission electron microscopy (TEM) image of Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 crystals shows polyhedral particles with a diameter of several micrometers and smooth surface ... a TEM image of EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 shows the loose surface structure, which consists of numerous irregular-shaped particles with a grain size of ∼10-20 nm

Color-coded micrograph (red Co regions, cyan particle boundaries/outlines)

nodes.characterization_summary: EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 edge shows interplanar distances 2.42 Å and 2.10 Å at ~55° assigned to (1̅11) and (002) planes of cubic NiO/CoO along [110] axis with hexagonal geometry and dominant {110} facets. After 300h CA test, spacings 0.21 nm and 0.24 nm assigned to (200) and (111) planes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The atomic-scale scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) image of the edge of the EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 polyhedron displays interplanar distances of 2.42 and 2.10Å with a characteristic angle of ∼55°, which can be assigned to the (1̅11) and (002) planes of cubic NiO (JCPDS 65-2901) or CoO (JCPDS 65-2902)

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni:Co:O ratio of 10.01:39.62:50.37 with homogeneous distribution of Ni, Co, and O elements.
nodes.evidence_snippet: An energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) analysis reveals that the Ni:Co:O ratio of the product is 10.01:39.62:50.37

nodes.characterization_summary: Surface of EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 composed of {110}-exposed Ni-doped CoO and Co-doped NiO nanoparticles that are symbiotic and intertwined.
nodes.evidence_snippet: microscopic-level STEM-EELS mapping combined with atomic-scale STEM analysis unambiguously demonstrates that the surface of the EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 polyhedron is composed of {110}-exposed Ni-doped CoO and Co-doped NiO denoted Co_yNi_{1-y}O, which are symbiotic and are intertwined together

nodes.characterization_summary: Co 2p shows Co³⁺ at 779.3 eV, Co²⁺ at 780.6 eV; positive shift by 0.7 eV after activation. Ni 2p shows Ni³⁺:Ni²⁺ ratio increases from 1.65 to 2.62. O 1s shows O2 content increases from 35.0% to 66.8%. No significant change after 300h test.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the Co 2p spectrum of Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 exhibits two spin-orbit peaks ... the Co 2p_{3/2} binding energy of EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 shows a positive shift by 0.7 eV ... the Ni³⁺:Ni²⁺ ratio calculated from the fitted Ni 2p XPS spectra increases from 1.65 to 2.62

nodes.characterization_summary: Pristine shows F_{2g}, E_g, F_{2g}, A_{1g} modes at 182, 460, 503, 655 cm⁻¹. At -0.45 V vs RHE, spinel modes disappear and new peak at 532 cm⁻¹ for rock salt Co_yNi_{1-y}O appears.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Raman spectrum of pristine Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4 shows the characteristic peaks of F_{2g}, E_g, F_{2g}, and A_{1g} modes at 182, 460, 503, and 655 cm⁻¹ ... When the potential is increased to -0.45 V (vs RHE), these Raman-active modes attributed to the spinel structure disappear, whereas a new peak assigned to the rock salt structure (Co_yNi_{1-y}O) at 532 cm⁻¹ arises

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance C_dl of EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4/NF is 51.1 mF cm⁻², ~5 times greater than pristine.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the double-layer capacitance (C_dl) of EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4/NF is calculated to be 51.1 mF cm⁻², ∼5 times greater than that of Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4/NF

nodes.characterization_summary: Charge transfer resistance R_ct of EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4/NF is 1.5 Ω vs 3.4 Ω for pristine.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) of EA-Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4/NF shows a smaller charge transfer resistance (R_ct) of 1.5 Ω in comparison to that of Co_{3-x}Ni_xO_4/NF (3.4 Ω)
